chunks: And Abū Baṣīr narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If you intend to depart on the day of Eid, and dawn breaks while you are still in the town, then do not leave until you have witnessed that Eid."

key_terms.الشُّخُوصَ: departure or setting out on a journey
key_terms.تَشْهَدَ ذَلِكَ الْعِيدَ: attend or witness that Eid observance
key_terms.فِي الْبَلَدِ: being present in the town or locality
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْعِيدِ: the day of Eid, the occasion of the Eid observance

ai.seo_question: Can a person travel on the day of Eid after dawn if he is still in town?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding travel on the day of Eid. If a person is still in the town when dawn breaks, he should not depart until he has witnessed the Eid, indicating the importance of participating in the Eid observance.
